summary.text: Robbie Mahrou is an independent candidate for New Hampshire's 2nd Congressional District. According to Ballotpedia he works as a consultant; little additional biographical information is publicly available.

paragraphs.text: Graduated from Strake Jesuit College Preparatory and earned a bachelor's degree from Baylor University in 1999.
Lists his career experience as consultant; no prior elected office or earlier campaigns appear in the source.
